name: Arona Hiiragi
source: Arona (known as Aro-chan) is a 16-year old female student from Hanatani High School with no love interest with anyone in her way. She likes to make friends, and somehow likes to friendzone whenever someone asks her to be their own girlfriend. A heartbreaker at first, but she doesn't like to be shipped by someone. An important to note; February is her most least month of all 12 months because it involves her most least thing to do.
